rules.message: Tests must not read or write the real home directory: use createSandbox() from test/helpers/sandbox.mjs and its sb.home, sb.env and sb.join().
rules.origin: Hard rule 3 of this project (tests only use temporary directories and never touch the user's real settings); made a rule before any test broke it

rules.message: Write the byte order mark as the escape \uFEFF: the character itself is invisible in a diff and in most editors, so nobody can see that it is there or check it.
rules.origin: Found in 16 places in 15 source files written from P0 to E1a (registry, report, gates, profiles, verify, tests): the escape was meant, the invisible character was stored
